escaped     = "\" ( non-digit / dec-octet )
contiguous  = 1*( non-special / escaped )
quoted      = DQUOTE *( contiguous / ( ["\"] WSP ) ) DQUOTE

clauses.normalized_text: However, there are several differences:

clauses.normalized_text: SRV records are typically mandatory, whereas SVCB is intended to be optional when used with pre-existing protocols.

clauses.section_heading: Differences from the SRV RR type

clauses.normalized_text: SRV records cannot instruct the client to switch or upgrade protocols, whereas SVCB can signal such an upgrade (e.g. to HTTP/2).
clauses.raw_text: SRV records cannot instruct the client to switch or upgrade protocols, whereas SVCB can signal such an upgrade (e.g. to HTTP/2).
clauses.section_heading: Differences from the SRV RR type

clauses.normalized_text: SRV records are not extensible, whereas SVCB and HTTPS RRs can be extended with new parameters.

clauses.normalized_text: However, this would result in a serious performance impairment, because clients cannot rely on their recursive resolver to follow SVCB aliases (unlike CNAME).
